title: Slapsgiving
cn: 第 9 集 · 耳光感恩节
novel:
Marshall [[hosted|host]] Thanksgiving and prepared to [[deliver|deliver]] the third [[slap|slap]] to Barney. He had earned it months ago in a bet. Barney lived in [[dread|dread]], jumping at every sound.

Lily became a holiday-[[obsessed|obsess]] [[maniac|maniac]], [[decorating|decorate]] every corner. "It's [[tradition|tradition]]!" she [[declared|declare]], carving the [[feast|feast]] with [[anticipation|anticipation]].

The [[countdown|countdown]] began. Marshall [[taunted|taunt]] Barney all day. "Any moment now," he would say with a grin. Barney [[begged|beg]] for mercy.

As the family gathered around the table, Marshall [[raised|raise]] his hand. The [[slap|slap]] echoed through the apartment. Barney [[stumbled|stumble]] back, his face red. The table erupted in laughter.

"Happy Slapsgiving," Marshall said. Some [[traditions|tradition]], Barney [[realized|realize]], were worse than others.

obsess.en: to think about all the time
